unverified.compression_ratio: 9.1:1 per DieselHub. GM's 9.1:1 is for the HP3 crate engine, a different product. ItStillRuns and chevytrucks.org are not acceptable sources. Not counted.
unverified.rod_length_in: 6.385 in was not found in any acceptable source. Wikipedia says only 'longer connecting rods'.
unverified.years_end: DieselHub says truck use ended after the 2006 MY. The claim that the 2007 Silverado/Sierra Classic HD still offered it is not verified. Motorhome (Workhorse) and medium-duty (Kodiak/TopKick) use continued to 2009 (context only).
